'''''Lantana horrida''''' is a species of flowering plant in the [[Verbenaceae|verbena family]]. It is found in Mexico and the West Indies to subtropical South America. It lives in a variety of habitats, including tropical savanna, forest, montane, shrubland, and grassland.<ref name="sanders2012"/>

==Taxonomy==
''Lantana horrida'' was first described in 1818 by [[Karl Sigismund Kunth]].<ref name=ipni/> ''Lantana horrida'' <small>Kunth</small> is sometimes confused with ''[[Lantana urticoides]]'' as the latter has several synonyms previously described as [[form (botany)|forms]] of ''Lantana horrida''.<ref name=inatsim/><ref name=powo135351-2/> While ''Lantana urticoides'' ranges into Texas and New Mexico, ''Lantana horrida'' has not been documented north of Mexico.<ref name=powo/><ref name=powo135351-2/>
